summary: Li Bang International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its existing at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC, increasing the aggregate offering amount from $20 million to $60 million. The amendment does not change the nature of the program—an ordinary ATM shelf takedown—and does not constitute a special situation event. The registrant is the issuer relying on an effective F-3 shelf registration. The filing is a routine current report related to the upsizing of an existing equity distribution facility, not a transformative corporate event. No watch or risk-arb angle applies.
